edus.text: I invite Mr. Khoo Poay Tiong, Melaka City.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong ask the Minister of Communications and Digital to state the explanation of the new Mandatory Standard on Access Pricing (MSAP)
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: which came into effect in March 2023,
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: and what the impact will be on the telecommunications sector and users in Malaysia in terms of service quality.
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: Thank you, Your Honor, thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: The mandatory standard regarding access prices, with permission, Mandatory Standard on Access Pricing (MSAP) is one of the legal instruments issued by the Malaysian Communications and Multimedia Commission (SKMM)
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: to regulate access prices at the wholesale level or, with permission, wholesale to provide access services.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: Through the new MSAP
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: which came into effect on March 1, 2023,
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: the maximum access price has been set for 14 facilities and services listed for a period up to 2025.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: With the implementation of the new MSAP,
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: access service providers need to provide facilities
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: and services listed at a new maximum price to access service recipients as set by SKMM.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: A public investigation paper on MSAP was issued by SKMM on October 5, 2022 until January 17, 2023 to get recommendations and feedback from industry players and the public regarding the MSAP implementation method to be made.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: A total of 16 feedback has been received from relevant stakeholders
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: including Celcom, Digi, Telekom Malaysia Berhad and Digital National Berhad.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: All of these feedback have been studied
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: and considered by SKMM in determining the MSAP implementation method.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: In general, the price set in the new MSAP is lower compared to the previous MSAP.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: For example, the price for high-speed broadband wholesale services or, with permission, high speed broadband for 100 Mbps speed in the new MSAP for the year 2023 is RM254.64 per month
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: With the implementation of the new MSAP,
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: access service providers need to provide facilities
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: and services listed at a new maximum price to access service recipients as set by SKMM.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: A public investigation paper on MSAP was issued by SKMM on October 5, 2022 until January 17, 2023 to get recommendations and feedback from industry players and the public regarding the MSAP implementation method to be made.

edus.text: For example, the price for high-speed broadband wholesale services or, with permission, high speed broadband for 100 Mbps speed in the new MSAP for the year 2023 is RM254.64 per month
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: compared to the price of RM515 per month before.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: Therefore, it can reduce the cost to access service recipients involved in providing fixed broadband services to users.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: Indirectly, services provided to consumers at the retail or retail level can be offered at a lower and competitive price or at a higher speed.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: In terms of service quality, SKMM uses other instruments to regulate, including through the Mandatory Standard Quality of Service (MSQoS)
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: and the implementation of periodic audits against service provider companies.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, the Ministry of Health Malaysia has introduced an Action Plan to the direction of the Elimination of Serviks Cancer in Malaysia 2021-2030
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Puan Syerleena binti Abdul Rashid [Bukit Bendera]

edus.text: based on the Global Strategy to Accelerate the Elimination of Cervical Cancer as a Public Health Problem developed by the World Health Organization.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Puan Syerleena binti Abdul Rashid [Bukit Bendera]

edus.text: Therefore, the Ministry of Health strives to ensure that:
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Puan Syerleena binti Abdul Rashid [Bukit Bendera]

edus.text: ( i ) 90 percent of HPV vaccination coverage for girls before they are 15 years old;
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Puan Syerleena binti Abdul Rashid [Bukit Bendera]

edus.text: ( ii ) 70 percent screening coverage by using the latest methods that are proven to be scientifically effective for women aged 35 and 45 at least twice in life; and
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Puan Syerleena binti Abdul Rashid [Bukit Bendera]

edus.text: ( iii ) 90 percent of positive women get early intervention and treatment for precancers.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Puan Syerleena binti Abdul Rashid [Bukit Bendera]

edus.text: This action plan is a framework that includes the goals and targets of elimination by 2030.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Puan Syerleena binti Abdul Rashid [Bukit Bendera]

edus.text: since he has an emergency matter that needs to be managed in his area.

edus.text: ( i ) 90 percent of HPV vaccination coverage for girls before they are 15 years old;

edus.text: In order to set the direction of this action plan,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Puan Syerleena binti Abdul Rashid [Bukit Bendera]

edus.text: there are five priorities of the Ministry of Health, namely:
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: ( i ) strengthen governance and policies;

edus.text: ( ii ) enrich access and participation;
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Puan Syerleena binti Abdul Rashid [Bukit Bendera]

edus.text: ( iii ) improve service delivery;

addressees: Puan Syerleena binti Abdul Rashid [Bukit Bendera]

addressees: Puan Syerleena binti Abdul Rashid [Bukit Bendera]

edus.text: and ( v ) monitoring, evaluation and research.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Puan Syerleena binti Abdul Rashid [Bukit Bendera]

edus.text: Until now there are several achievements of this action plan that have been achieved by the Ministry of Health as follows:

edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Puan Syerleena binti Abdul Rashid [Bukit Bendera]

edus.text: ( i ) the formation of the National Serviks Cancer Elimination Program Steering Committee
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Puan Syerleena binti Abdul Rashid [Bukit Bendera]

edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Puan Syerleena binti Abdul Rashid [Bukit Bendera]

edus.text: ( ii ) the increase in the level of public health literacy regarding the importance of cervical cancer screening is one of the strategies to increase screening coverage that can be achieved through the development of the Strategic Communications Plan;
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Puan Syerleena binti Abdul Rashid [Bukit Bendera]

edus.text: and ( iii ) ensure that women get access to HPV tests through the expansion of HPV screening tests to all states.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Puan Syerleena binti Abdul Rashid [Bukit Bendera]

edus.text: The Ministry of Health also aims to increase HPV test screening access to PeKa B40 recipients.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Puan Syerleena binti Abdul Rashid [Bukit Bendera]

edus.text: Discussions have been held to establish a collaboration with ProtectHealth Corporation Sdn. Bhd.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Puan Syerleena binti Abdul Rashid [Bukit Bendera]

edus.text: to achieve those aspirations.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Puan Syerleena binti Abdul Rashid [Bukit Bendera]

edus.text: The Serviks Cancer Management Guidelines Committee is currently in the final stage of the review of the Guideline for Cervical Cancer Screening in Malaysia (2nd Edition).

addressees: Puan Syerleena binti Abdul Rashid [Bukit Bendera]

addressees: Puan Syerleena binti Abdul Rashid [Bukit Bendera]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, a little more.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Tuan Lim Guan Eng asked the Minister of Natural Resources, Environment and Climate Change to state about the Mengkuang Water Dam listed by SPAN as one of the seven high-risk water dams in Malaysia by stating actions that can be taken to overcome weaknesses,
edus.speaker: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]
addressees: Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: and will allocations be given to help the Mengkuang Dam not become high-risk in order to be able to carry out functions guaranteeing continuous and strong water supply, to consumers in Penang.
edus.speaker: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]
addressees: Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: Honorable Minister of Natural Resources, Environment and Climate Change.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]
addressees: Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Yang di-Pertua and Yang Berhormat Bagan.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: The statement issued by SPAN recently is based on the Water Supply Monitoring Report 2022 regarding high-risk dams.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: I would like to clarify that the Risk Assessment of this dam takes into account the age, record levels,
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: and also the dam's water reserves, as well as the number of water treatment plants in the dam area.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: This is not related to the safety of the dam's own structure.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: That has another report issued by the flying squad that examines the conditions of the dams in our country.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: LRA Sungai Dua has a design capacity of 1,228 million liters a day
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: which represents almost 77 percent of the water supply for the entire state of Penang,
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: because there is a submarine pipe connecting Seberang Prai
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: and also Penang.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: Water from the Mengkuang Dam which is a strategic dam will be released
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: when the quality of Sungai Muda is affected,
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: due to floods or low river water levels during the dry season.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: In order to ensure the sustainability of water supply, SPAN has taken the following initiatives:
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: ( i ) has drawn up nine identified action plans
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: including strengthening communication plans between stakeholders, coordination with water supply operators and sewerage as well as actions that need to be taken by SPAN.

edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: During the Special Sessions of The World Had An Assembly to Consider Developing A World Health Organization WHO Convention Agreement or Other International Instrument of Pandemic Prepared and Response, with permission, held on 29 November to 1 December 2021, member countries with the WHO have also agreed as follows Mr. Speaker, with permission, I read it in English.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, the issue regarding towers without pans or towers without 4G or Internet services that has been raised for a long time in the state of Sarawak has finally found a solution by the Federal Government through the Malaysian Communications and Multimedia Commission ( MCMC ).
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: This SMART 600 project involves the construction and operation of 600 telecommunication towers by companies owned by the Sarawak State Government, namely tower operators, with capital expenditure of more than RM1 billion for all the towers fully financed by the Sarawak State Government.

edus.text: However, the location of these SMART 600 towers is located in rural areas where the commercial return is very limited,

addressees: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Thank you Your Honor.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, the issue regarding towers without pans or towers without 4G or Internet services that has been raised for a long time in the state of Sarawak has finally found a solution by the Federal Government through the Malaysian Communications and Multimedia Commission ( MCMC ).
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: This SMART 600 project involves the construction and operation of 600 telecommunication towers by companies owned by the Sarawak State Government, namely tower operators, with capital expenditure of more than RM1 billion for all the towers fully financed by the Sarawak State Government.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: However, the location of these SMART 600 towers is located in rural areas where the commercial return is very limited,
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: causing the mobile service provider to find it difficult to reach a commercial agreement with the tower operator for the provision of 4G services.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: This thus becomes the cause of the existence of pan-less towers in the state of Sarawak.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: In order to ensure that 4G services can be provided to the local community in those areas immediately
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: and take into account the investment that has been made by the Sarawak State Government,
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: basically the Federal Government,
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: and the main mobile service providers namely CelcomDigi, Maxis, U Mobile, TM Tech and YTL Communications have agreed to share the costs that need to be paid to the tower operator.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: For information, funding from the Federal Government and the mobile service provider company involves a sum that does not exceed RM207 million
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: which is RM119.4 million by the Federal Government through MCMC and the Ministry of Finance and RM87.3 million by mobile service providers companies for related towers for a period of three years starting from 2024 to 2026.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: After that period, mobile service providers will fully cover the cost of payment to tower operators.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: A total of 3,000 rural and rural areas have been identified
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: causing the mobile service provider to find it difficult to reach a commercial agreement with the tower operator for the provision of 4G services.

edus.text: After that period, mobile service providers will fully cover the cost of payment to tower operators.

edus.text: A total of 3,000 rural and rural areas have been identified
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: and will be able to benefit under this initiative.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: With this initiative, it will end the issue of pan-less towers that has been going on since 2019 in Sarawak.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: The operation of this tower for the provision of 4G services is in stages
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: and will start as early as January 2024.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: If not,
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: earlier than that.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: Apart from that, the 4G service in these SMART 600 towers will also be provided by the five mobile service providers
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: involved in this sharing model, namely CelcomDigi, Maxis, U Mobile, TM Tech and YTL Communications,
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: thus being able to provide more options to users.
edus.speaker: Menteri Komunikasi dan Digital [Tuan Ahmad Fahmi bin Mohamed Fadzil]

edus.text: The implementation of this initiative is also part of the JENDELA plan which aims to provide 100 percent Internet coverage in populated areas at the end of 2025 in addition to being a catalyst

edus.text: `` 1220 Mr. Speaker, I request that it be negotiated under Meeting Rule 18 ( 1 )
edus.speaker: Dato' Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]

edus.text: on the issue of dropout of Malaysian Certificate of Education ( SPM ) graduates.
edus.speaker: Dato' Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]

edus.text: This is because recently it was reported that approximately 458,000 SPM students did not continue their studies to a higher level within three years since 2020 until 2022.
edus.speaker: Dato' Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]

edus.text: Among the reasons why the students did not continue their studies
edus.speaker: Dato' Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]

edus.text: is due to family financial constraints and their own pocket money tendencies.
edus.speaker: Dato' Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]

edus.text: Recently the Minister of Education announced that a total of 14,858 students did not attend the SPM exam in 2022
edus.speaker: Dato' Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]

edus.text: compared to 10,681 students who did not attend in 2021.
edus.speaker: Dato' Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]

edus.text: This increase is very worrying
edus.speaker: Dato' Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]

edus.text: because students are the heir generation of national and national leadership.
edus.speaker: Dato' Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]

edus.text: Most SPM graduates prefer to engage in manufacturing sector jobs and food or goods delivery services.
edus.speaker: Dato' Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]

edus.text: There are also a few SPM graduates who choose not to continue higher studies or work to the point of falling into social problems.
edus.speaker: Dato' Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]

edus.text: For example, the Batu Pahat Traffic Investigation and Enforcement Division has recently arrested a total of 71 16- to 27-year-old motorcycle riders who race illegally.
edus.speaker: Dato' Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]

edus.text: If this problem is not taken seriously by the government,
edus.speaker: Dato' Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]

edus.text: it is feared that the future of these students will be dark
edus.speaker: Dato' Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]

edus.text: and will further harm the country
edus.speaker: Dato' Seri Dr. Shahidan bin Kassim [Arau]

edus.text: because they are a valuable gem for the country.

edus.text: Tuan Jimmy Puah Wee Tse asked the Minister of Women, Family and Community Development to state what steps the ministry is taking to reduce the increasing cases of child abuse in Malaysia
edus.speaker: Tuan Jimmy Puah Wee Tse [Tebrau]
addressees: Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]

edus.text: and what assistance will be given to children who are abused after being found?
edus.speaker: Tuan Jimmy Puah Wee Tse [Tebrau]
addressees: Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Tebrau.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, there are various factors that lead to abuse.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Among them are drug abuse, alcohol influence, family relationship problems, mental or emotional health and others.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: In general, cases of child abuse can occur
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: when children are in the care of their own family members
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: and also when children are in the care of others, such as caregivers either at home, daycare or daycare.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: As a measure to reduce the risk of child abuse while in the care of others, especially in daycare, the Department of Social Welfare ( JKM ) has outlined several improvements to implement, among them the following things:
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: ( i ) we streamline our enforcement team and under this initiative the establishment of the Department of Child Development I just announced before that.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: We will reorganize the placement of officers in each district by placing officers
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: who will focus on carrying out monitoring duties and enforcement actions, especially for daycare centers and daycare only.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: This will start in 43 districts identified as risky areas
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: and we will implement it this year as well;
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: ( ii ) we tighten the rules and guidelines for the installation of CCTV in daycare.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Third, we too.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Apart from that, we also, entrepreneurs need to ensure that there are no blind spots or with permission, blind spots in CCTV coverage except for privacy places such as bathrooms and clothing dressing places;
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: and also when children are in the care of others, such as caregivers either at home, daycare or daycare.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: As a measure to reduce the risk of child abuse while in the care of others, especially in daycare, the Department of Social Welfare ( JKM ) has outlined several improvements to implement, among them the following things:

addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]

edus.text: ( ii ) we tighten the rules and guidelines for the installation of CCTV in daycare.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Third, we too.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Apart from that, we also, entrepreneurs need to ensure that there are no blind spots or with permission, blind spots in CCTV coverage except for privacy places such as bathrooms and clothing dressing places;
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: ( iii ) tighten the screening process for the recruitment of caregivers in daycare and also daycare centers.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: JKM will discuss together with the Ministry of Home Affairs
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: and also the PDRM to explore the proposal to require a screening of safety for candidates who want to work as caregivers.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Next, we will also see these babysitter candidates whether together with daycare operators will be required to undergo psychometric tests.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Meanwhile, efforts to reduce the risk of child abuse while in family care require a different approach.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: This is because KPWKM and JKM have direct control over daycare and daycare centers through the provisions of the law and regulations set.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: While abuse in the community or family itself covers a wider range of factors, beyond the jurisdiction and capabilities of KPWKM and JKM alone.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: However, among the efforts that have been planned to be implemented is the Awareness Program Against Punishment on Child Abuse, the Child Empowerment Program
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: and also Empowering the Community.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Next, in this regard, KPWKM's approach has protected
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga dan Masyarakat [Dato’ Sri Hajah Nancy binti Shukri]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: At the Hangzhou Asian Games recently, the Malaysian contingent consisting of 288 athletes has successfully won as many as six gold medals, eight silver medals and 18 bronze medals bringing the total number of 32 medals
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]

edus.text: and has achieved the target given by the National Sports Council and the Malaysian Olympic Council.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]

edus.text: On this occasion, I would like to thank Chef de Mission, Dato' Chong, Deputy Chef de Mission, National Sports Council, National Sports Institute and the Malaysian Olympic Council for your efforts and hard work in making the Asian Games this time a success for Malaysia.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]

edus.text: 13 types of medal contributors show good progress compared to the 2018 Asian Games in Jakarta–Palembang, Indonesia and the 2014 Asian Games, Incheon, South Korea.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]

edus.text: We still achieve more than the medal target even though two types of sports, namely tenpin bowling and silat, are not contested in the Hangzhou Asian Games this time.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]

edus.text: This is because two types of tenpin bowling and silat sports have contributed as many as 12 medals at the 2018 Asian Games.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]

edus.text: For further planning, the National Sports Council will hold an Asian Sports Performance Review Workshop with related stakeholders in the near future
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]

edus.text: and will involve experts from Nippon Sport Science University on November 8.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]

edus.text: For the Cambodia SEA Games as well, the same post-mortem workshop has been held to improve the existing program.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]

edus.text: For the information of Honorable Members, national athletes have shown extraordinary performance this time in their respective events and this successful performance that has been arranged has paid off.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, I beg to propose: That this Council take a resolution for the government to transfer a total of RM35,045 million or RM35.045 billion
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: which is the remaining receipt of the Malaysian Government Investment Issue, with permission, the Malaysian Government Investment Issue (MGII) of RM31,834 million or RM31.834 billion and the Malaysian Islamic Treasury Bill, with permission, Malaysian Islamic Treasury Bills (MITB) of RM3,211 million or RM3.211 billion under section 3 (1) of the Government Funding Act 1983 [Act 275]. to the Development Fund specified in the Second Schedule of the Financial Procedures Act 1957 [Act 61] for the purpose of the money group being approved.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, I request to present a resolution related to the transfer of money of the Malaysian Government Investment Issue
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: and the Malaysian Treasury Bill to the Development Fund in accordance with the requirements of section 4(b) of the Government Funding Act 1983 [Act 275].
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: This resolution is presented so that the government transfers the remaining received money of the Malaysian Government Investment Issue, with permission, Malaysian Government Investment Issue and Malaysian Islamic Treasury Bills, with permission, Malaysian Islamic Treasury Bills for 2022 amounting to RM35,045 million or RM35.045 billion to the Development Fund.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: This transfer is implemented to finance part of the development expenditure requirements for 2022 - not next year yes - as approved by Parliament.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: This Parliament has even passed during the presentation of the 2022 Budget in 2021.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: The Development Fund is a government trust fund established under the Development Fund Act 1966 for the purpose of financing development projects.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: Development Fund (KWP) account fund sources are obtained through transfers from Consolidated Revenue Accounts, Consolidated Loan Accounts, loan repatriation and various receipts for development.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: In general, transfers from Consolidated Loan Accounts to Development Funds consist of receipts of Malaysian Government Securities Issue, with permission, Malaysian Government Securities (MGS), Malaysian Government Investment Issue, with permission, Malaysian Government Investment Issue (MGII), Treasury Bills and foreign loans.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: Section 4 (b) of Act 275 provides that receipts from Malaysian Government Investment Issue and Malaysian Islamic Treasury Bills can only be transferred to the Development Fund
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: after obtaining the approval of the Dewan Rakyat with a resolution.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: This is the resolution I read.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: For the information of Honorable Members, this loan security based on sharia principles has been published by the government under Act 275,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: and one of the main purposes of this issue is to develop
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: and develop the Islamic financial market.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri Kewangan [Datuk Seri Haji Ahmad bin Haji Maslan]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, with this, I request to propose a resolution related to the transfer of the remaining received money of the Malaysian Government Investment Issue and Malaysian Islamic Treasury Bill for 2022 amounting to RM35,045 million to the Development Fund.

edus.text: Honorable members, the minister's question this morning is welcome by the Honorable Tuan Cha Kee Chin, Rasah.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Mr. Cha Kee Chin asked the Prime Minister to state whether YB Bagan during his tenure as Minister of Finance from May 2018 until February 2020,
edus.speaker: Tuan Cha Kee Chin [Rasah]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: has cancelled the Albukhary Foundation's tax exemption,
edus.speaker: Tuan Cha Kee Chin [Rasah]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: and the reason for the cancellation was made by the Inland Revenue Board ( if any ).
edus.speaker: Tuan Cha Kee Chin [Rasah]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: When did the cancellation of the tax exemption come into effect and be reinstated.
edus.speaker: Tuan Cha Kee Chin [Rasah]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: What amount of money did the Albukhary Foundation receive and the benefits to the Federal Government from the tax exemption.
edus.speaker: Tuan Cha Kee Chin [Rasah]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Please Your Excellency the Prime Minister.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, I would like to inform Mr. Speaker that I will answer only two questions
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: because I have to go to the Istana Negara to welcome the President of Singapore.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Good Honorable.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, the Albukhary Foundation has been granted approval under subsection 44 ( 6 ), Income Tax Act 1967, Act 53
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: which is exempt from income tax.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: The government confirmed from the records of the Ministry of Finance that Yang Berhormat Bagan during his tenure as Minister of Finance has never made any cancellation to the previous taxation approval
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: that was allegedly given to the Albukhary Foundation.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Therefore, the allegation made that he canceled the exemption is not true.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: This is because the fact is, approval was only made on 25 February 2021,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: which is the approval of tax exemption which is unusually involving both the Albukhary Foundation and the Albukhary Group.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Regarding the method raised, I have explained that it is not a common thing in the records of the Ministry of Finance.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: I can not extend it
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: because this case is still under investigation and action by the MACC and the court.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: It's just that our approach is certainly different from before, which is to ask big companies to transfer big finances, give exemptions and then donate to parties or individuals.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: I chose to call Tan Sri Syed Mokhtar to guarantee support for projects that benefit the country and for the benefit of poor rice farmers,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: because this is involved with BERNAS,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: ask him to donate to rice farmers directly.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: So, RM60 million to rice farmers and 30 percent of the profits recorded for more than 20 years, this is the first time we ask him to give 30 percent of net profit to rice farmers.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: So, there is a different approach.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: One, can leave it to the party, one leave it to rice farmers.

addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: I choose to leave it to rice farmers.

edus.text: Regarding specific questions about interest rates, I would like to state
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: that we impose Islamic financial instruments.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: So with a minimum service cost but not measuring in terms of conventional bank interest even though we do not prevent
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: if there are members whether Muslims, especially non-Muslims, who will choose to borrow according to conventional methods.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: However, the EPF chose to ask members to use the Islamic loan method with the minimum interest rate which is certainly lower than the market loan rate.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: However, I would also like to explain
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: because there is a misunderstanding about Account 2 which can still be used as we announced previously loans for education, Hajj and other facilities, sick to go to the hospital, that has not changed.

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: However, from the point of view of guaranteeing the interest of the borrower, for example,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: there is none - dividends will continue
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato’ Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

addressees: Tuan Hassan bin Abdul Karim [Pasir Gudang]

edus.text: We are looking for other ways to help and I explain for example the difference between the workers and the farmers, fishermen that we help separately to reduce their burden and also the assistance to civil servants.

edus.text: Welcome Honorable Tenom, Mr. Riduan bin Rubin.

edus.text: Tuan Riduan bin Rubin asked the Minister of Entrepreneur Development and Cooperatives to state what the ministry's role is in coordinating the implementation of entrepreneurship and PMKS development programs by other ministries and agencies, especially to avoid overlapping assistance and programs.
edus.speaker: Tuan Riduan bin Rubin [Tenom]
addressees: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: Honorable Minister.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]
addressees: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: For the information of the Honorable and this honorable House, the Ministry of Entrepreneur Development and Cooperatives is responsible as the main coordinator of the implementation of entrepreneurship initiatives
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: implemented by various ministries and agencies including implementation at the state level.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: In order to ensure that the development and coordination of entrepreneurship initiatives runs smoothly and there is no overlap,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: the governance structure has been formed at the federal and state levels.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: At the Federal level, the National Entrepreneur and Industry, Micro, Small and Medium Development Council ( MPUPK ) chaired by the Honorable Prime Minister or the Honorable Deputy Prime Minister is the highest body responsible
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: for setting the direction and policy of entrepreneur development and PMKS comprehensively across all economic sectors.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: While at the state level, the National Entrepreneurship Development Council ( MPKN ) chaired by the Minister in this ministry has been established
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: to coordinate the policy and direction of entrepreneurship development between the Federal Government and the state government as well as coordinate the implementation of entrepreneurship initiatives
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: so that they are more planned and strategic.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: The implementation of the functions of MPUPK and MPKN is assisted by several working committees,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: namely the PMKS Supreme Level Special Task Force and the National Entrepreneurship Development Technical Committee which is headed by the Chief Secretary to the Ministry and the Chief Secretary to the ministry.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: In the ministry's efforts to ensure that the implementation and needs of entrepreneurs, cooperatives, hawkers and small traders can be dealt with in a targeted manner and resolved thoroughly, a special committee which is the District Entrepreneur, Cooperative, Hawkers and Small Traders Development Council which will be chaired by district officials has been formed and will start or even be implemented in a pilot manner starting in Sabah.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: While in Sarawak, it will be implemented through the divisional entrepreneur development council chaired by the Deputy Resident and it will be expanded throughout the country.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: In addition, the ministry through SME Corp also coordinates, monitors and evaluates the performance and achievements of the entrepreneur and PMKS development programs on an annual basis through the SME Integrated Action Plan ( SMEIPA ).
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: The SMEIPA system has been developed to facilitate the coordination of planning reporting and achievements of the PMKS development program at the Federal and state levels.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Dato' Ramli bin Dato' Mohd Nor]

edus.text: Your Honor, this ministry has specifically held an engagement session with the Sabah State Government and the Sarawak Government,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: especially in increasing the coordination of entrepreneurship development programs involving the ministry and both state governments.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: For the state of Sabah, this ministry held a courtesy session with the Yang di-Pertua Negeri Sabah and the Honorable Chief Minister of Sabah on 12 December 2022 to provide information on the function of agencies under the ministry that can benefit PMKS entrepreneurs in Sabah.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: This session was followed by discussions with the Ministry of Industrial Development and Entrepreneurship Sabah to detail cooperation on the implementation of entrepreneurship development programs in Sabah.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: Further, this ministry and the Sabah Government held an engagement session with Sabah state-level associations and cooperatives on 30 January 2023
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: and several follow-up actions were also implemented after that including a special coordination meeting regarding halal certification issues in Sabah including in collaboration with JAKIM and MUIS.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: Overall, the findings of the matter raised include financial assistance to entrepreneurs and cooperatives, physical infrastructure facilities for entrepreneurs and also to digital entrepreneurs, promotional activities and the delivery of information related to programs and entrepreneurship assistance in Sabah.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: As for Sarawak, a courtesy visit session to the Honorable Premier of Sarawak on 9 February 2023.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: The Ministry held discussions with the Sarawak Ministry of International Trade, Industry and Investment on the role that can be implemented by the ministry agencies in Sarawak
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi [Datuk Ewon Benedick]

edus.text: in helping to improve entrepreneurship development initiatives and programs in Sarawak.

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, I beg to move that the Penal Code (Amendment) Bill (No. 2) 2023 be read for the second time now.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Mr Speaker, the Bill that I am tabling is the Criminal Procedure Code (Amendment) Act (No. 2) 2023,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: which seeks to amend the Criminal Procedure Code [Act 593], which arises from amendments to the Penal Code [Act 574], among others, to abolish the offence of abetment of attempted suicide by a child, a person of unsound mind, or any person, as a criminal offence.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: This Bill was tabled for its first reading on 4 April 2023 together with the Penal Code (Amendment) Bill (No. 2) 2023.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Mr Speaker, in general, the amendments to Act 593 involve two clauses, as follows:
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: ( i ) clause 1 contains the short title and provisions relating to the commencement of the proposed Act;
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: ( ii ) seeks to amend the First Schedule to Act 593, arising from amendments made to sections 305 and 306 of the Penal Code [Act 574], and the repeal of section 309 of the Penal Code.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: The amendments involved in the First Schedule to Act 593 include replacing the particulars relating to section 305 of the Penal Code with new particulars as set out in the schedule in clause 2.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Further amendments relate to the particulars concerning section 306 of the Penal Code in column (2) of the First Schedule, by inserting the words 'or attempted suicide' after the words 'of suicide' under that section.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: This matter is in line with the purpose of introducing the offense of attempted suicide by any person other than the category of individual person specified under the amendment of section 305 of Act 574.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: The last amendment involved is to cut the details related to section 309 of the Penal Code and the details related to it.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Through the repeal of section 309 of the Penal Code,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: attempted suicide is no longer an offense under Act 574 after this.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: With this Mr. Speaker, I beg to propose.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Undang-undang dan Reformasi Institusi) [Tuan Ramkarpal Singh a/l Karpal Singh]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Does anyone support?
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: I beg your support.

addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail asked the Prime Minister to state the possibility that the Federal Government's decision to move from the single wholesale network model to the dual network resulted in some harm or effects such as international contract default, good governance violations, cyber security risks, surges in financial implications for the government and 5G tariff increases for consumers.
edus.speaker: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail [Ampang]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Ampang.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: On May 3, 2023, the government decided to continue with the implementation of 5G and switch from single wholesale network to dual network model due to some justifications, increase competition
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: and end the monopoly elements associated with DNB, offer network diversity
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: and overcome the issue of single failure points in the single wholesale network model
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: and involve existing telecommunications companies so that they can be more comprehensive
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: and guarantee the sustainability of the telecommunications industry ecosystem in Malaysia which has been led by the private sector.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, this transition is a difficult decision
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: because we are under pressure from various parties
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: who want to maintain a network
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: and are not happy with Malaysia's more independent attitude to choose the required network system,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: whether in the west or in the east.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: However, the decision of the Cabinet is finally for the sake of national security and our freedom to choose with strict conditions,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: which is to set the conditions of all telcos using the existing structure DNB network until 80 percent of the network is completed.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Then ensure that the connectivity is carried out,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: including in the countryside, inland.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: If this is agreed upon,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: then after using the same facility, telcos that have recorded very good profits have been required to invest so
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: that they guarantee safety not only from the point of view of facilities to all its connectivity people.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: who want to maintain a network
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: and are not happy with Malaysia's more independent attitude to choose the required network system,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: whether in the west or in the east.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: However, the decision of the Cabinet is finally for the sake of national security and our freedom to choose with strict conditions,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: which is to set the conditions of all telcos using the existing structure DNB network until 80 percent of the network is completed.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Then ensure that the connectivity is carried out,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: including in the countryside, inland.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: If this is agreed upon,
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: then after using the same facility, telcos that have recorded very good profits have been required to invest so
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: that they guarantee safety not only from the point of view of facilities to all its connectivity people.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Secondly, the issue of cyber security through the National Cyber Security Agency which will monitor together.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: The implications for the government are greatly reduced
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: because of the involvement of telcos and the second strict condition is that the price for consumers must be at a low level as we ensure it is set under DNB regulations.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Finally, the role of SKMM is because control is very limited now.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Therefore, regulations and laws will be streamlined
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: so that SKMM can control the telco journey more effectively, including two networks after the initial preparation under DNB.
edus.speaker: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: if - I want to ask two more questions,
edus.speaker: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail [Ampang]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: if the implementation by DNB reaches 80 percent as informed later,
edus.speaker: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail [Ampang]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: will the second network only focus on providing 20 percent coverage remaining.
edus.speaker: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail [Ampang]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Is it like that or revamped as a whole?
edus.speaker: Puan Hajah Rodziah binti Ismail [Ampang]
addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: Secondly, we see that the use of this internet network is quite a conversation on 4G services that we see there are more weaknesses and failures.

addressees: Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan [Dato' Seri Anwar bin Ibrahim]

edus.text: My second question, what are the government's steps to ensure that 5G services after DNB is taken over by the provision of telecommunications services reach an optimal quality level?

edus.text: and will be implemented by the ministry to help small rubber farmers

edus.text: Assalamualaikum warahmatullahi wabarakatuh.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Kuala Pilah.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: Tan Sri Yang di-Pertua, first of all the government is aware of the low rubber price challenge faced by smallholders.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: Therefore, the government has implemented several initiatives to help small rubber farmers as follows.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: First of all, Rubber Production Incentive ( IPG ).
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: The government is very concerned and listens to the complaints of smallholders,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: especially when they are treated through ministry programs such as the Commodity Track Program.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: Therefore, the government and the presentation of the 2024 Budget have agreed to increase the rate of activation price ( PHP ) for IPG from RM2.70 to RM3.00 per kilogram with an allocation of RM400 million.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: This increase in incentive rates is expected to ease the burden of smallholders
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: when there is uncertainty in the rubber price level.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: For information, until August 2023, the granting of IPG has benefited 217,705 smallholders with a payment of RM474.54 million.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Sri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]
addressees: Dato' Adnan bin Haji Abu Hassan [Kuala Pilah]

edus.text: This IPG program has been implemented since September 2015.

addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: because it was one of the few countries whose role was very important in determining our further struggle.

addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Unity and common voices from the countries in question are very important
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: and Malaysia is in that group once.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: In the meetings I attended together with MBS, with President Erdogan, with the President of RCC, I witnessed how the hopes of these leaders see Malaysia that can play a very important role in the term used, connecting the dot.

edus.text: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat asked the Minister of Transport to state the extent
edus.speaker: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]

edus.text: to which the KTMB Shuttle Tebrau service ridership between JB Sentral and Woodlands, Singapore has recovered to a level before Covid-19.
edus.speaker: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]

edus.text: Is the government willing to negotiate with Singapore to increase the service capacity from 36 bilateral trips to at least 50 trips to meet the people's demand?
edus.speaker: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]

edus.text: Thank you Tan Sri Yang di-Pertua.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: For the information of the Honorable Member Pulai, the number of passengers of the Shuttle Tebrau service between JB Sentral and Woodlands, Singapore has recovered
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: and even recorded a very encouraging increase.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: For the year 2023, the average passenger per day was 8,635 people, an increase of seven percent compared to the previous passenger record of COVID-19, which is a total of 8,077 people per day in 2019.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: The government has also held discussions with Singapore, through the Malaysia-Singapore Joint Ministerial Committee for Iskandar Malaysia platform
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: For the information of the honorable House, the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Program or in short TVET in this country is implemented
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: and managed across 12 ministries and involves the participation of public skills training institutions providers or for short ILKA and private skills training institutions ( ILKS ).
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: There are a total of 1,295 TVET institutions including ILKA and ILKS that are currently operating by offering TVET programs that are suitable for the target group set.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: Referring to the latest UNESCO data stating that only five percent of Malaysian youth are involved in the field of TVET,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: this statement is based on the involvement of youth between the ages of 15 and 24 years.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: This takes into account the country's youth population in the same age range,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: totaling as many as six million people based on statistics from the Department of Statistics Malaysia or DOSM.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: The data stated by UNESCO is in line with enrollment statistics for 2021 showing that the number of youth in the same age category participating in the TVET program is 360,000 people.

edus.text: the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Council (MyTVET) was established on 18 December 2020
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: and acted as the highest body to make decisions related to the country's TVET direction where its membership is across all ministries, TVET providers and various related stakeholders.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: Under the Unity Government,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: MyTVET in the country on 7 February 2023 discussed appropriate measures that can be taken by the government for improvements to the country's TVET ecosystem through strategic cooperation with government-related companies (GLCs)

edus.text: and also private companies.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: the implementation of TVET program collaboration specifically according to the field at ILKA with private companies or GLCs will be implemented immediately through the signing of the MOA memorandum of agreement.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: if we compare it with private hospital services.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: Therefore, this government hospital is the focus.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: That's why if we look at it,
