edus.text: the government has also increased the number of doctors, all nurses have increased
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: but are still facing congestion.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: So, for that reason, the government has already established a Special Task Force for Public Sector Reform (STAR) chaired by Tan Sri KSN
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: and is made up of various agencies.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: Not only the Ministry of Health, but various ministry agencies and so on where they discuss sit down to see what other improvements can be made.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: For that, they implement programs in a short-term, mid-term and long-term manner where cooperation with the private sectors, private hospitals and also medical practitioners, private clinics to share, where some patients who may not face critical diseases will be able to get medicine in private clinics.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: Likewise those who come especially during odd hours from 6 to 12 pm,
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: if not critical they can be sent to a nearby health clinic, a district clinic where their operating hours will be extended until 12 pm.

edus.text: This is a short-term step
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: and also a moderate step is implemented.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: As announced in the recent budget, the Madani Medical Scheme has also been allocated specifically, where allocations will be given for our people to go to see private general medical practitioners (GPs) to do non-critical treatment
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: or normal fever and so on.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: or promote a healthy living culture.

edus.text: This is very important as a preventive measure that we should focus on.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Perladangan dan Komoditi [Dato’ Seri Haji Fadillah bin Yusof]

edus.text: This is where I think the role of all Members of Parliament for us to carry out programs together with the Ministry of Health, doctors to give awareness to practice this healthy living culture among our people,

edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: The implementation of the HIS @ KKM system in the KKM hospital is phased according to the project approved under the Rolling Plan of the Malaysia Plan ( RP RMK ), where the 11th RM RP4 has as many as seven hospitals in Negeri Sembilan will be involved through the National EMR Project.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: While for the 12th RM RP2, a total of seven more KKM hospitals across the country will be involved in the implementation of this HIS @ KKM system, this digitalization at the primary health care level, namely KK, has started since 2005 with the use of the TPC system and beyond, the TPC–OCHIS system in 2017 in health clinics and also dental clinics in an integrated manner.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: This system allows all patient care processes from registration
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: and patient records are stored electronically.

edus.text: This allows patient health records to be shared in any health clinic that uses the system I mentioned earlier, TPC–OCHIS.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: The data in this system is also used for reporting for the purpose of planning the health program as well as supplying data to mobile applications as lifelong health records.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: So, until now we have 103 health clinics equipped with this TPC–OCHIS system and 42 health clinics in Negeri Sembilan will be equipped with the same system through the National EMR Project as I mentioned earlier.

edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: Indeed, this is our dream.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: Finally, one day, all patients can actually keep them with their own medical records.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: When they go to any clinic, they can release their data.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: So, actually to answer that, we- as many as this, only 27.5 percent of hospitals have a general patient management system and only 9.5 percent of health clinics, another 4.4 percent of dental clinics that have the system I mentioned earlier TPC - OCHIS.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: So, our main challenge is actually to get or provide this comprehensive digitization, we need a very high budget, Your Honor.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: The budget can sometimes reach billions.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: So, why is this implementation - what actually contributes to the high budget is
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: because it needs infrastructure upgrades.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: So, buildings also need to be suitable
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: if we want to use this digitization system, with its wiring and so on.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: Then, equipment.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: Sometimes our equipment is old equipment.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: So, we have to upgrade the equipment by either repairing it
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: or we have to find a new one.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: That also contributes to the high budget needs.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: Of course, the others are the system itself, the system, then the cloud system and so on.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: So, this is what sometimes means we also need of course, finally this complete implementation or the universal thing moving forward, we also need from the cooperation of the Ministry of Finance, God willing.

edus.speaker: Dato' Dr. Zulkafperi bin Hanapi [Tanjong Karang]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: We are confident that medical records or HIS can help reduce congestion in hospitals, especially in emergency units
edus.speaker: Dato' Dr. Zulkafperi bin Hanapi [Tanjong Karang]

edus.text: and also in health clinics.
edus.speaker: Dato' Dr. Zulkafperi bin Hanapi [Tanjong Karang]

edus.text: However, it does not mean that
edus.speaker: Dato' Dr. Zulkafperi bin Hanapi [Tanjong Karang]

edus.text: if there is a shortage of doctors and medical staff, they will not be able to accommodate a large number of patients.
edus.speaker: Dato' Dr. Zulkafperi bin Hanapi [Tanjong Karang]

edus.text: So, I would like to ask here.
edus.speaker: Dato' Dr. Zulkafperi bin Hanapi [Tanjong Karang]

edus.text: What is the justification when the Madani Government through the Public Service Department no longer sponsors any scholarships for critical fields such as medicine, pharmacy, dentistry and nursing?
edus.speaker: Dato' Dr. Zulkafperi bin Hanapi [Tanjong Karang]

edus.text: We know that the cost of medicine is too high.
edus.speaker: Dato' Dr. Zulkafperi bin Hanapi [Tanjong Karang]

edus.text: We are confident that this will reduce the ability of the Malays to continue medical fields and in the long term will reduce the number of doctors from the Malay race.
edus.speaker: Dato' Dr. Zulkafperi bin Hanapi [Tanjong Karang]

edus.text: Thank you.

edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Dato' Dr. Zulkafperi bin Hanapi [Tanjong Karang]

edus.text: It requires integrated cooperation as well between the Public Service Department (JPA), also the Ministry of Finance (MOF), and I also include within our ecosystem the preparation of doctors—

edus.text: For the information of Honorable Members, the Uniform Building Bylaw of 1984 (UKBS) is a subsidiary law under the Road, Ditch and Building Act [Act 133].
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Kerajaan Tempatan [Tuan Nga Kor Ming]

edus.text: UKBS in 1984 has gone through the review process for amendments,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Kerajaan Tempatan [Tuan Nga Kor Ming]

edus.text: starting from 2018 to May 2021.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Kerajaan Tempatan [Tuan Nga Kor Ming]

edus.text: The Ministry of Local Government Development through the Local Government Department (JKT) has made an amendment 2021 to the Uniform Building Bylaw which covers five main components involving 114 amendments, namely:
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Kerajaan Tempatan [Tuan Nga Kor Ming]

edus.text: (i) Fire safety requirements
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Kerajaan Tempatan [Tuan Nga Kor Ming]

edus.text: involving 73 amendments;
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Kerajaan Tempatan [Tuan Nga Kor Ming]

edus.text: (ii) communication - two amendments;
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Kerajaan Tempatan [Tuan Nga Kor Ming]

edus.text: (iii) industrial building system (industrial building system) - 17 amendments;
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Kerajaan Tempatan [Tuan Nga Kor Ming]

edus.text: (iv) the presentation of online development plans - four amendments;
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Kerajaan Tempatan [Tuan Nga Kor Ming]

edus.text: and lastly (v) regulation of construction quality - 18 amendments.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Kerajaan Tempatan [Tuan Nga Kor Ming]

edus.text: The amendment has been approved by the Cabinet Meeting on 23 June 2021
edus.speaker: Menteri Pembangunan Kerajaan Tempatan [Tuan Nga Kor Ming]

edus.text: That is why we see that the verification process at the District Disaster Committee level needs to be improved.
